encoding: Interleaved Uint8 RG. R = ESA WorldCover class (2021), G = approximate signed coast distance in 2 m units, biased by 128; positive is land. North row first.
attribution: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium. Shoreline: Statistics Canada, 2021 Census Cartographic Boundary Files, used under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
worldCoverCitation: Zanaga et al. (2022), ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7254221
limitations: Source land cover is 10 m classification. Bundled classes have been resampled to ~47 m. Canopy positions, species mix and field microtextures are synthesized, not a tree survey; tide is not simulated.
